• SHOT 1 (0–2s | Macro Detail): Extreme macro close-up of a smoldering ceramic incense burner (pedupaan); grey kemenyan smoke curls past the sinister carved wooden face of an antique shadow puppet (wayang kulit). 
• SHOT 2 (2–4s | Human Action): Medium shot as Maya walks slowly down the dark wooden hallway, her bare feet creaking on warped floorboards, her trembling hand shielding the flickering kerosene lamp flame from a cold draft.

• SHOT 4 (6–9s | Environmental Scale): Extreme wide low-angle shot as a sudden blinding lightning flash illuminates the entire rotting Joglo exterior, surrounded by towering ancient banyan trees with tangled hanging roots whipping in the storm. 
• SHOT 5 (9–12s | Creeping Tracking): Slow, low Steadicam tracking shot moving behind Maya as she reaches the open doorway; the wind suddenly blows out her kerosene lamp, plunging the frame into suffocating darkness except for cold moonlight. 
• SHOT 6 (12–15s | Horror Climax Frame): Sudden lightning strike illuminates the end of the hallway: a tall shrouded white figure (Pocong) @[Image 2](image_2) with blackened facial hollows stands motionless in the corner. Maya freezes in silent, gasping terror. Final frame holds 1.5s.

prompt seedance 2.0 

Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic villa film using the uploaded reference sheet as the strict visual guide.

REFERENCE:
The sheet shows three views of one tropical villa: exterior, living room, and pool terrace. Use each panel to guide its corresponding shot. The video must show full-screen scenes, never the reference sheet itself, a collage, panel borders, or labels.
Maintain the villa’s cream limestone walls, flat roof, teak accents, glass doors, ivory sofa, wooden coffee table, travertine terrace, rectangular infinity pool, and two loungers. Preserve the architecture and furniture placement across shots.

0–5 SECONDS — EXTERIOR
Begin with the exterior composition from the first reference panel, looking across the pool toward the villa. Slowly move the camera forward at eye level. Gentle ripples animate the reflections. Palm leaves sway slightly. Warm interior lamps glow behind the glass. Keep the entire building stable and sharply defined.

5–10 SECONDS — LIVING ROOM
Clean cinematic cut to the interior composition from the second reference panel. The ivory sofa and wooden coffee table occupy the foreground, with the pool and forested valley visible through the open glass doors. Slowly slide the camera to the right, creating subtle natural parallax. The sheer linen curtain moves gently in the breeze. Warm sunlight reveals the fabric and stone textures.
10–15 SECONDS — POOL TERRACE
Clean cut to the third reference composition: villa on the left, infinity pool on the right, green valley beyond. Slowly move backward along the terrace to widen the view. Small ripples catch the sunlight. Ease the camera to a stop during the final second, ending on an elegant architectural composition.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Premium architectural film, natural golden-hour lighting throughout, restrained warm color grading, realistic exposure, straight vertical lines, smooth stabilized movement, and clearly visible material textures. Moderate wide-angle lenses without distortion. Quiet, intimate, luxurious atmosphere.
SOUND:
Soft water movement, a gentle breeze, distant birds, and understated ambient music without vocals. Continuous sound across the cuts.

AVOID:
People, text, logos, changing architecture, moving furniture, warped walls, distorted glass, flickering textures, sudden lighting changes, extreme lens flare, fast camera movements, speed ramps, and morphing transitions.

提示词 seedance 2.0

使用上传的参考图作为严格的视觉指南，创建一个 15 秒的写实电影感别墅短片。

参考说明：
图板展示了同一座热带别墅的三个视图：外观、客厅和泳池露台。每个面板用于引导其对应的镜头。视频必须显示全屏场景，绝不能显示参考图本身、拼贴、面板边界或标签。
保持别墅的米色石灰岩外墙、平屋顶、柚木装饰、玻璃门、象牙白沙发、木质茶几、洞石露台、矩形无边泳池和两把躺椅。在各镜头间保持建筑与家具陈设一致。

0–5 秒 — 外观
从第一个参考面板的外观构图开始，越过泳池望向别墅。以与眼睛齐平的高度缓慢向前推进镜头。轻柔的涟漪使水面倒影活起来。棕榈叶轻微摇摆。温暖的室内灯光在门后透出。保持整栋建筑稳定、轮廓锐利清晰。

5–10 秒 — 客厅
干净的电影感硬切至第二个参考面板的室内构图。象牙白沙发和木质茶几位于前景，透过打开的玻璃门可见泳池和绿意山谷。缓慢向右滑移镜头，形成自然的视差。轻盈的亚麻窗帘在微风中轻柔摆动。温暖的阳光显现出织物与石材的质感。
10–15 秒 — 泳池露台
干净硬切至第三个参考构图：别墅在左侧，无边泳池在右侧，翠绿山谷在远处。沿露台缓慢向后移动以拓宽视野。小涟漪捕捉阳光。在最后一秒从容停机，停在一个优雅的建筑构图中。

摄影指导：
高端建筑影片风格，全程自然黄金时刻光线，克制的暖色调调色，真实的曝光，笔直的垂直线条，平滑稳定的运镜，材质纹理清晰可见。使用中度广角镜头无畸变。营造静谧、私密、奢华的氛围。
声音：
柔和的水流声、轻柔的风声、远处的鸟鸣，以及低调的无人声环境音乐。声音在剪辑间保持连续。

避免出现：
人物、文字、标志、建筑变更、家具移动、墙面弯曲、玻璃变形、纹理闪烁、光线突变、强烈镜头眩光、镜头快速移动、变速加速和变形转场。
